newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt paper firm raises 95/96 profit.
newsitem.headline: Egypt paper firm raises 95/96 profit.

text.p: Rakta/General Paper Industry increased net profits for the 1995/96 financial year to 36.82 million pounds from 34.43 million in the previous year, results published on Saturday showed.
The financial year ends on June 30.
The net profit is slightly higher than the 35.7 million pounds which corportate sources reported earlier this year.
The firm said it would distribute 3.68 million pounds of this profit to shareholders compared to the 1.63 million pounds it gave out in 1994/95.
Institutional investors hold almost all of the firm's 8.695 million privatised shares. The state's Holding Company for Chemical Industries is the majority shareholder.
Rakta gave out a 1.00 pound dividend for 1994/95 but did not post a yield for 1995/96.

In September, corporate sources said Rakta's board has proposed issuing a free share for every four to all those who hold shares on December 5. The free shares will increase capital to 21.738 million pounds from 17.39 million and the firm will hold its annual board meeting on December 10.
Rakta's results showed its sales for 1995/96 were lower at 188.01 million pounds compared to 208.78 million in the previous year.
Sales by the company were hard hit during the year by a Ministry of Education decision to buy from other companies and by stiff competition from imported paper, the sources also said.
The Egyptian stock exchange was closed on Saturday for the weekend. Rakta shares closed on Thursday 1.00 pounds higher at 19.50 pounds.
